minimumDefaultError: The right rightAxis-axis labels and color legend overlap; guides require more margin space or different offsets.
description: Native default right legend starts at plot edge+8 regardless of an existing named right Y axis, then eager guide collision rejects a chart with ample right margin. Explicit offset90 succeeds, proving the failure is placement, not unavailable Canvas space. No public types/new option is needed for inferred placement to account for right-axis occupied extent.
